main.description: System user and group under which the service runs for privilege separation.

imap.description: Connection and authentication details for the source IMAP server.

host.description: IMAP server hostname or IP address.

port.description: IMAP server port (143 for non-SSL, 993 for SSL).

ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS for the IMAP connection.

mailbox.description: IMAP mailbox name to pull messages from.

username.description: IMAP login username (often full email address).

password.description: IMAP login password (store securely in production — e.g., via secrets manager or file permissions).

fetch_batch_size.description: Number of messages to fetch per IMAP batch to avoid timeouts.

delivery.description: Delivery method: either SMTP (multiple servers supported) or LMTP (single socket).

smtp_servers.description: List of SMTP relay servers (host and port).

lmtp_socket.description: Path to LMTP Unix socket (only used if method=lmtp).

tls.description: Optional client-side TLS for outbound SMTP/LMTP connections.

enable.description: Enable TLS for outgoing SMTP/LMTP connections.

ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for verifying the server certificate.

client_cert.description: Optional client certificate for mTLS (leave blank to disable).

client_key.description: Optional client private key (must match client_cert).

logging.description: Verbosity, syslog facility, and optional file log target.

log_file.description: Path to file where logs are written (empty = no file logging).

limits.description: Resource and rate limits to prevent overload.

max_concurrent_jobs.description: Maximum parallel message deliveries at once.

max_message_size.description: Largest message size (in bytes) to process. 0 = unlimited.

rate_limit_per_minute.description: Maximum messages delivered per minute (0 = unlimited).

add_received.description: Add a 'Received:' header showing this forwarder's action.

add_date.description: Ensure each message has a Date: header (add if missing).

replace_from.description: If non-empty, overwrite the From: header with this email address (e.g., for aliasing).
